diagram_math_checks.justification: def-additive-ode-and-partition defines a,b:U -> R^d. Vertices represent the same stage states Y1,Y2,Y3 in the assigned Definition, not functions or exact subflows. Component evaluations at a source stage are understood only where the original stage equations are defined; the caption makes no existence or uniqueness assertion.

Definition line 37 has nonzero entries tilde A21=gamma, tilde A31=delta, tilde A32=1-delta. The directed edges Y1->Y2, Y1->Y3 and Y2->Y3 carry respectively gamma h a, delta h a and h(1-delta)a, with a evaluated at their source as captioned. There are no reversed or additional explicit dependencies.

Definition line 38 has A22=gamma, A32=1-gamma, A33=gamma, all other entries zero. Thus the Y2->Y3 edge also contributes h(1-gamma)b(Y2), and the self-loops at Y2 and Y3 contribute gamma h b(Y2) and gamma h b(Y3). These are precisely the implicit terms in lines 40-41. Two self-loops mark the two nonzero diagonal stages; no loop at Y1 is present.

The caption explicitly adds the common y to every target stage equation, as lines 40-41 require. Y1=y is labelled at the initial vertex; Y3=y+ at the last vertex follows the exact equality y^+=Y3 in line 41. Matching last tableau rows with the displayed weights also confirms the same update.

Arrows denote algebraic weighted contributions, not maps, geometric trajectories, or positive weights; in particular delta<0 is retained exactly. The original definition and its explicit non-solvability caveat remain intact, and no rigorous argument depends on the added illustration.
